_comment: Every tool that declares reach anyone, with the reason it is safe: the in-code guard it relies on (callers list, presence proof, own-scope check, held at the Gate), or read-only. A tool with a mutating verb in its name needs a reason that names a guard; read-only does not count. PENDING reasons are tracked and shrink. test/reach-anyone.test.js fails on an anyone with no entry.

artifacts.archive.reason: own-scope check: reach() in core/artifacts/index.js runs on the artifact's own project for the caller (an agent reaches only its thread's project or what it made; a # tag grants read of one item only), and an agent's writes are marked untrusted

artifacts.create.reason: own-scope check: target() puts an agent's artifact only in its own project (or its own space); the maker is recorded from the call, never the input; content is secret-scanned only for a share

artifacts.delete.reason: own-scope check: reach() in core/artifacts/index.js runs on the artifact's own project for the caller (an agent reaches only its thread's project or what it made; a # tag grants read of one item only), and an agent's writes are marked untrusted; a delete keeps 30 days to undo

artifacts.diff.reason: read-only, scoped by the module itself

artifacts.export.reason: own-scope check: reach() in core/artifacts/index.js runs on the artifact's own project for the caller (an agent reaches only its thread's project or what it made; a # tag grants read of one item only), and an agent's writes are marked untrusted; export only reads: it returns the file to the caller and changes nothing

artifacts.get.reason: read-only, scoped by the module itself

artifacts.list.reason: read-only, scoped by the module itself

artifacts.move.reason: own-scope check: reach() in core/artifacts/index.js runs on the artifact's own project for the caller (an agent reaches only its thread's project or what it made; a # tag grants read of one item only), and an agent's writes are marked untrusted; an agent may move only into its own project

artifacts.public.status.reason: read-only, scoped by the module itself

artifacts.restore.reason: own-scope check: reach() in core/artifacts/index.js runs on the artifact's own project for the caller (an agent reaches only its thread's project or what it made; a # tag grants read of one item only), and an agent's writes are marked untrusted; going back is a new version, nothing is lost

artifacts.search.reason: read-only, scoped by the module itself

artifacts.share.reason: held at the Gate: it declares outward post, so an agent's call waits for the person (the in-tool check also refuses an agent without the gate's mark), and the secret scan refuses a share that looks like it holds a key

artifacts.undelete.reason: own-scope check: reach() in core/artifacts/index.js runs on the artifact's own project for the caller (an agent reaches only its thread's project or what it made; a # tag grants read of one item only), and an agent's writes are marked untrusted

artifacts.unshare.reason: own-scope check: reach() in core/artifacts/index.js runs on the artifact's own project for the caller (an agent reaches only its thread's project or what it made; a # tag grants read of one item only), and an agent's writes are marked untrusted; it only stops a link, so it is never held

artifacts.update.reason: own-scope check: reach() in core/artifacts/index.js runs on the artifact's own project for the caller (an agent reaches only its thread's project or what it made; a # tag grants read of one item only), and an agent's writes are marked untrusted
